newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 18.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 18.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones gained 20.02 points to 6,955.48. PLDT's ADR rose $0 1/8 to $60.
* The peso closed lower 26.341 from 26.334 to the dollar.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index dipped 2.93 points to 3,231.86.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was unchanged at 10.03125 percent.
* The benchmark Treasury bill rate fell to single digit level for the first time since September 1995 to only 9.804 percent on Monday. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
* Newspaper BusinessWorld says ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp advertisers are seeking a meeting with the television station to resolve the 22 percent advertising rate hike issue.
* Inquirer says Port operator International Container Terminal Services declared on Monday a 50 percent stock dividend.
* Times Journal says Jardine Davies Corp doubles its capital from 1.3 billion pesos in 1995 to 3.2 billion pesos last year.
* Manila Standard reports Cosmos Bottling Corp announced that Paribas Principal Investment (Paribas) acquired a "substantial amount" of company shares and would be invited to the board.

* Philippine Star says Victorias Milling Corp and its 32 creditor banks failed to sign an agreement with the banks for a 90-day reprieve on its 4.4 billion peso maturing obligations following an issuance of a "notice of garnishment" by the court.
